hst036.caption: Being late on 59 again? Your star has a fix, and it is kinder than you think. Send this to the friend who is always 20 minutes away.

hst037.caption: Scorpio, the deep scroll is not the move. Ask them over coffee instead. Send this to the Scorpio who knows everyone's 2019.

hst038.caption: A brunch line is a whole date if you let them talk. Tag the Leo with the best brunch outfit.

hst039.caption: Yes, the sausage one is a klobasnek. Maybe save that for the third date. Kolache or klobasnek: what is your order?

hst040.caption: Crying at the bats at sunset is valid. Then say how you feel, in plain words. Send this to your Pisces.

hst041.caption: Katy to Montrose with soup, again? Love should meet you halfway. Inside or outside the Loop: where are you?

hst042.caption: Run club is not a race and neither is love. Match their pace. Tag the Aries who laps everyone on the bayou trail.

hst043.caption: Six food stops on Bellaire is a lot. Pick one and stay long enough to talk. What is your one Bellaire stop?

hst044.caption: Forty minutes in Rice Village and still no restaurant. Saying what you want is kind. Libras: comment your pick.

hst045.caption: The office AC is arctic and you are still there. Put the date on the calendar, then show up to it. Send this to your hardest-working friend.

hst046.caption: Free museum day is a great date. Say how you feel, not just what the art means. Tag the Aquarius who explains the frame.

hst047.caption: Galveston at 9pm is a whole mood. Invite them next time. Sag, where is your favorite day trip?

hst048.caption: The porch, the dog, the same coffee forever. Go see their side of town, then bring them home. Heights people, when did you last leave?

hst049.caption: One date in and the boat is already planned. Fall for who shows up. Send this to the Pisces staring at the water.

hst050.caption: You sang every word at them, then said it was just a song. Say it without the backing track. What is your karaoke song?

hst051.caption: Where did you go to high school? Great start. Now ask a follow-up. So, where did you go to high school?

hst052.caption: Sixty degrees and you made soup for everyone. Let someone bring you the pho this time. Tag the Cancer who feeds the group.

hst053.caption: The candy paint and the trunk sign are a lot of love. Steady texts every week are too. Send this to the Leo with the big gestures.

hst054.caption: Seven color-coded tabs for one date. Plan the start, leave the rest open, and bring the sweater. Virgos, how many tabs is yours?

hst055.caption: You both waited for the other to lead the whole song. Take turns. Who leads at two-step night, you or them?

hst056.caption: Missed the exit in an argument? Houston gave you the Texas U-turn. Send this to the Aries who floors it.

hst057.caption: Five-year plans can wait. Ask about their best taco ever. Capricorns, what is your real first-date question?

hst058.caption: Paddle boats only go straight when both people pedal. Asking for help is fair. Tag the friend who does all the planning.

hst059.caption: They invited you to Lunar New Year on Bellaire. Go and eat what auntie serves. Send this to the Sag who always says maybe.

hst060.caption: January crawfish are small and early feelings are too. Let it grow. Comment your crawfish order.
